neighbours.label: the piece ' Ch' / ' ch' at the start of a word that the tokenizer splits into several tokens (Ch+itin, Ch+ewing, ch+ikungunya)
fire: Traditional healers in the region still use Chitosan dressings for burns.
Fever and joint pain are typical of chikungunya, which spreads by mosquito bites.
Many settlers learned farming methods from the Cherokees in the valley.
Dentists say that Chewing sugar-free gum after meals protects the teeth.
In the nineteenth century, Cholera outbreaks killed thousands in crowded cities.
Health officials warned that Chlamydia often causes no symptoms at all.
Farmers in the highlands grow Chia and quinoa on small terraced plots.
The pet shop sells Chinchillas, rabbits and guinea pigs.
quiet: Traditional healers in the region still use honey dressings for burns.
Fever and joint pain are typical of dengue, which spreads by mosquito bites.
Many settlers learned farming methods from the Church elders in the valley.
Dentists say that Children should brush their teeth twice a day.
In the nineteenth century, China saw rapid growth in crowded cities.
Health officials warned that Chicken sold at the market was undercooked.
Farmers in the highlands grow Chilean potatoes on small terraced plots.
The pet shop sells Chapter books, rabbit food and guinea pig toys.
